# Test fixtures

All images are public-domain works of NASA (U.S. Government works), downloaded as 1280 px
thumbnails from Wikimedia Commons:

- `crew_group.jpg` — STS-114 crew portrait. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:STS-114_crew.jpg
- `person_a_portrait.jpg` — Commander Eileen Collins. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Commander_Eileen_Collins_-_GPN-2000-001177.jpg
- `person_b_portrait.jpg` — Wendy Lawrence. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wendy_Lawrence_NASA_STS114.jpg

They are used only to verify face detection and identity matching across photos
(both people also appear in the crew photo). No wedding photographs are included.
